begin_of_turn_query.content: Ensure the fuel tank is replenished adequately by adding 38 liters of gasoline so that we're well-prepared for the lengthy voyage ahead. Only fill with interger amount for volumn; round when not integer. Once fueled, proceed to start the engine confidently with the ignition mode, and make certain that all doors are secure, and the parking brake is engaged as a safety measure.
